lines.text: When opening a pull request, run the comprehende skill from skills-next on that PR using the local built CLI, export the review, then host that folder with the pages skill. Put the printed URL in the PR body.

After a change under `skills-next/comprehende/`, `src/schema/`, or `src/review/`, run `pnpm eval -- --tag smoke` and put the summary lines in the PR body. `pnpm eval` needs `CURSOR_API_KEY`. LLM findings do not change the exit code.

After a change under `skills-next/comprehende/`, `src/schema/`, or `src/review/`, run `pnpm eval -- --tag smoke --no-graders` and paste the summary lines in the PR body. Needs `CURSOR_API_KEY`. Exit 1 means validate broke or an expect drifted from current product. Smoke does not run graders.

A merge to `main` that touches those paths (or `scripts/eval/`, `eval/cases/`) runs the full graded suite: workflow `.github/workflows/eval.yml`, repo secret `CURSOR_API_KEY`. A failed job is the regression ping. If that secret is unset, the workflow skips; launch a cloud agent after the merge and run `pnpm eval`. Manual full suite is for skill redesign.
## Notes from Máté, the repo owner

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/eval.yml b/.github/workflows/eval.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1c0e045
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/eval.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+# Full graded eval after skill, schema, review, or harness land on main.
+# Needs repo secret CURSOR_API_KEY. Skips (does not fail) when that secret is unset.
+# Event-driven: path filter on main, plus workflow_dispatch. Not a cron.
+
+name: Eval suite
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - "skills-next/comprehende/**"
+      - "src/schema/**"
+      - "src/review/**"
+      - "scripts/eval/**"
+      - "eval/cases/**"
+      - ".github/workflows/eval.yml"
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+concurrency:
+  group: eval-suite
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  eval:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+      - uses: pnpm/setup@v2
+        with:
+          runtime: node@24
+          cache: true
+          install: false
+      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      - name: Full graded eval
+        env:
+          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [ -z "${CURSOR_API_KEY}" ]; then
+            echo "Repo secret CURSOR_API_KEY is not set. Skipping the full graded suite."
+            echo "Add it under Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions."
+            echo "::warning::CURSOR_API_KEY secret missing; full eval skipped"
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          pnpm eval -- --json
+      - name: Upload eval run
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: eval-run
+          path: eval/runs
+          if-no-files-found: ignore
